user_goal: Forecast multiple currencies jointly within fixed, training-fitted clusters
screen_scope: Historical scalar Ridge models fitted to separately routed currency-month rows
screen_scope_exclusions: Joint multivariate neural inputs and outputs
Cluster or regime context used as an auxiliary model input

membership_timing.fixed_groups: A grouping fitted entirely through a training cutoff may label that training history and remain frozen for later validation/test
membership_timing.dynamic_descriptors: Use causal origin-time states over a fixed currency/channel axis
membership_timing.target_maturity: Include a training target only if its endpoint is at or before the fit cutoff

historical_screen.interpretation: Exploratory scalar-routing diagnostic; does not determine the joint forecasting design

reference_limitations: Deterministic snapping does not imply universal unchanged-data invariance
Return/risk profile grouping differs from synchronous co-movement clustering
Squared-distance clustering remains sensitive to extremes and feature/scaling choices
Silhouette and turnover do not establish neural forecasting improvement
